admission.justification: Error cutting inside the measured bound is proved by the named passing final-measure case; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every short form carrying an error.
conditions: The error is cut to 600 chars, then end-reduced until the measured form fits 400.
errorCut marks a cut error; the detail file holds it whole.
statement: Errors are cut to 600 chars then end-reduced until the measured whole fits 400 with errorCut, the full original detail preserved beside it.
